episode.title: A New Idea for the Cafe
goal: I can read activity plans and choose one that fits.
活動の計画を読み、条件に合うものを選べる。
intro: Claire wants weekly workshops at the cafe. Emma suggests postcards. Nao suggests clay cups, and Leo suggests pastry decorating. They cannot do everything. They need to check the costs, time, and number of people.
クレアはカフェで毎週ワークショップを開きたいと思っています。エマははがき、ナオは陶芸のカップ、レオは菓子パンの飾り付けを提案します。全部はできません。費用、時間、人数を確認する必要があります。
episode.warmup: What can you say in this situation?
words: 残りを取っておけます。
discussion: II. Use two of the new expressions to talk about this situation.
この場面について、新しい表現を二つ使って話しましょう。
episode.followup: What question can you ask next?

rule: Use How many for things you can count.
数えられるものには How many を使います。
examples: How many cups do we need?
カップはいくつ必要ですか。

rule: Use How much for an amount or price.
量や値段には How much を使います。
examples: How much pasta do we need?
パスタはどのくらい必要ですか。

situation: Read Claire's three workshop proposals. All costs shown are total costs for one session.
クレアの三つの提案を読みましょう。費用はすべて一回分の合計です。
apply.text:
First workshop budget: 6,000 yen

Postcard design - Emma
Materials: 2,000 yen. Printing: 1,000 yen.
One hour. Eight places.

Clay cup activity - Nao
Materials: 4,500 yen. Equipment: 2,000 yen.
Two hours. Six places.

Pastry decorating - Leo
Ingredients: 3,500 yen. Supplies: 1,500 yen.
One hour. Eight places.
questions: Which plans take one hour for eight people?

choose: How (many / much) cups do we need?
How (much / many) pasta do we need?
choices: Which plans take one hour for eight people?

situation: You are Emma. Your tutor is Claire. She has written an updated plan for the first Saturday workshop. Read it and help her choose an option.
あなたはエマ役、講師はクレア役です。クレアが最初の土曜日のワークショップの計画を更新しました。読んで、選ぶのを手伝いましょう。
task: Read the new options. Check the cost, time, and people. Choose a plan and explain the jobs.
新しい案を読み、費用、時間、人数を確認しましょう。案を選び、担当を説明しましょう。
mission.title: First Saturday Workshop - Updated Plan
mission.text:
Available time: 3-4 p.m. | Group: eight people | Budget: 6,000 yen.

Option A: Postcard design
Paper and pens: 2,400 yen. Printing: 800 yen. Total: 3,200 yen.
One hour. Eight people.
Emma prepares designs; Claire handles booking.

Option B: Clay cups
Materials and equipment: 5,800 yen total.
Two hours. Six people.
Nao prepares tools; Claire handles booking.

All listed costs are per session, not per person. Keep the remaining money for the next workshop.
lines: Which plan fits the budget, time, and group?
Clay cups cost 5,800 yen now. Does that make them suitable?
What is the postcard total? How much is left?
What will you prepare? What will I do?
What time and how many people?
mission.evidence: A fits1hour/eight/6000; B costs5800 but2hours/six fails; A3200 leaves2800; Emma designs/Claire booking; Saturday3-4/eight. Accept polite explanation grounded in the card.

trivia: “Per person” means for each person. A 3,000-yen total for a group is different from 3,000 yen per person.
per person は一人当たりです。グループ全体で3,000円と、一人当たり3,000円は違います。
triviaQuestion: Does “per person” mean for the whole group?
No. It means for each person.
episode.closing: Claire chooses a small first workshop rather than doing everything at once. Meanwhile, someone who saw Nao's exhibition asks to buy a handmade ceramic set.
